item.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
item.description: A complete rundown of the most important events across the music business.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen’s Anti-ICE Song ‘Streets of Minneapolis’ Makes No. 1 Sales Debut
item.description: The song was the most-downloaded in the U.S. despite just two days of availability during the tracking week.

item.title: Chappell Roan Is ‘Giggling’ Over Reaction to Her Sheer Grammy Dress: ‘I Don’t Even Think This Is THAT Outrageous of an Outfit’
item.description: The pop singer/songwriter made headlines with the bold nipple-ring dress.

item.title: Nicki Minaj Says It Was the ‘Bullying’ President Trump Faced, Not His Policies, That Made Her Step Into Politics
item.description: The rapper explained that she felt she could relate to the way the president "was being treated."

item.title: Pandora Settles Lawsuit Over Royalties for Robin Williams, George Lopez & More Comedy Routines
item.description: The streamer says the deal doesn't alter its existing royalties structure for comedy sets.

item.title: 2026 Grammys Share the Love Among Pop Winners Lola Young, Lady Gaga, Billie Eilish, Olivia Dean & More
item.description: On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast, Katie & Keith are talking about Sunday's show, where four different artists won in the Big Four categories.

item.title: Kelly Clarkson to End Daytime Talk Show After 7 Years
item.description: The host said she made the decision to “prioritize my kids, which feels necessary and right for this next chapter of our lives.”

item.title: 16 Last-Minute Super Bowl Party Decorations for a Touchdown-Worthy Celebration
item.description: From serving tools to football-themed decor, consider this your shopping guide for gathering all the essentials.

item.title: Is NFL’s Roger Goodell Expecting Another Anti-ICE Message From Bad Bunny at Super Bowl? ‘This Platform Is Used to Unite People’
item.description: The NFL commissioner is asked whether Bunny would make a political statement during halftime, like he did at Sunday's Grammys.

item.title: Chuck Negron, Founding Member of Three Dog Night, Dies at 83
item.description: Negron’s lead vocals powered many of the band’s biggest hits, including “Joy to the World,” “One,” “Easy to Be Hard,” “Old Fashioned Love Song”, and “The Show Must Go On.”
